title: Fix token bucket rate limiter refill logic
prompt: The class TokenBucket in starter/token_bucket.py implements a token-bucket rate limiter. __init__(rate, capacity) sets the fill rate (tokens per second) and the maximum capacity. consume(n, now) attempts to consume n tokens at time `now` (a float, seconds). It must first refill tokens based on elapsed time since the last call (tokens = rate * elapsed, capped at capacity), then consume n tokens if available and return True, or return False without consuming if insufficient. The starter has two bugs: (1) it adds tokens without capping at capacity, and (2) it does not update self._last after a failed consume, so time keeps accumulating wrongly. Fix both. Do not edit the tests.
